handy_command.label: Handy command
handy_command.description: Command name or absolute path used to start and control Handy. Use this for non-standard installs such as an AppImage or a user-local binary.

data_dir.label: Data directory
data_dir.description: Override Handy's data directory (history.db, logs, recordings). Leave empty for the default location.

refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval
refresh_seconds.description: How often the service checks Handy's state and history, in seconds.

model_refresh_seconds.label: Model refresh interval
model_refresh_seconds.description: How often the downloaded-model list is read from Handy's tray menu, in seconds.

history_limit.label: Transcripts shown
history_limit.description: Maximum number of transcripts listed in the panel.

transcript_lines.label: Transcript preview lines
transcript_lines.description: How many lines of each transcript to show before clicking to copy it.

show_state_text.label: Show state text
show_state_text.description: Show REC / … / OFF next to the bar icon instead of only changing the glyph.
